transformations: Filtered, deduplicated and aggregated from preserved sources. See the processing report and configuration for scope and exclusions. Display boundaries generalised by the source API; native Esri rings grouped into polygons, degenerate source rings omitted with indexed audit, and exterior/hole traversal adapted to Vega without inventing retained coordinates. No invented records or ecological results.
rights_notice: Source rights remain applicable. Some retained occurrence data are noncommercial; preserve CC BY-NC conditions and each provider attribution. No blanket licence is asserted for all source-derived assets.

tables.scope: All selected checklist entries; family/genus hierarchy, summed species_count.
All checklist families, including those with no retained occurrences.
Eight main jurisdictions. Species can occur in multiple states; state species counts are not additive nationally.

Same eight jurisdiction polygons; generalised display geometry with ring traversal adapted to Vega/D3 spherical conventions. Valid source rings retained; degenerate rings omitted with indexed audit. Ring order adapted to Vega; never used to calculate land area.
Retained occurrence records per calendar year; final year is partial.
Source-ranked examples; selection, full eligible counts and displayed sample counts.
Deterministic display sample only; never used to calculate other charts.
Entire selected checklist with unambiguous extant national threat matches, regardless of ALA coverage.
Configured number of tiles; rounded CR share, not one tile per species.
Leading families by matched threatened species, plus Other families; each species contributes once.
Indicative Yes jurisdictions from national listing data; not independent state legal assessments or ALA occurrence counts.
All published IBRA 7.1 bioregion summaries; separate geography from state charts.
Equal-width protection percentage bins; includes empty bins.
Full selected data universes and definitions; use for data-bound headlines.
Every contributing retained provider with original citation, rights, DOI and record count.
